note: Housing height (8.5 mm), tails (3.1 mm below the board) and the 1.02 mm hole pattern from Würth Elektronik's WR-PHD drawings (61300411821 and 61301011821, rev. 002.000, 2024-03-25), retrieved 20 November 2026; the series' other sizes are taken to share them.
